Searched 2026-10-21 and not found as a measurement: Onogi, Yokoyama, Iida and Yoshinaga 2023 (Euro-Acoustics, DOI 10.61782/fa.2023.0221) simulate offsets y/h = 0 and 0.37 (jet height relative to the edge over the cavity-throat height) as 'a practical range for human players', which is a simulation choice, not a measurement; its measured-player values come from Onogi, Yokoyama and Iida 2021 (Acta Acustica 5, 11) and the ranges from Ando 1970 (J. Acoust. Soc. Jpn. 26(6), 253-260), whose tables were not reachable. The offset controls even-harmonic content (Fletcher and Douglas 1980, JASA 68(3), 767-771; Coltman 2006, JASA 120(4), 2312-2319)
